test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-6) Official paper (Held On: 9 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
There is a group of six people S, V, O, Y, X and T, each having a different height. Each one of them is in a different class. O is taller than V but shorter than T. S, V and O are in class 9, 7 and 3, respectively. S is the tallest and in the highest class. X is taller than Y but shorter than V. T is in a class senior to Y but junior to V. X is in a class senior to V. 

Who is in a class senior but shorter than V?
solution:
No. of persons- 6

Name of persons- S, V, O, Y, X and T

 
• Firstly, arranging them in the order of their classes:

1. S is in the highest class. S, V and O are in class 9, 7 and 3, respectively. X is in a class senior to V.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6d81c17a6309b0d8cb69008304e8f906eb28760b18776f76c2a2a336dd5285cf.png] 

2. T is in a class senior to Y but junior to V.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d1ab337964c3c789a59f0ae0d6d3e899d444e795bf096148e50bc1cd7b8ce1e0.png] 

 
• Then, arranging them in the order of their height:

1. O is taller than V but shorter than T. X is taller than Y but shorter than V.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/26b4abe81c920d2d09d7faed022531d49571c9ac1be41f28e3181c3645b7d6ce.png] 

2. S is the tallest in the highest class.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f281f50f85ecfc038818f1c4b19a11a262f3faa571232f2792020ecf2a8574d7.png] 

Persons senior to V in all cases: S and **X**

Persons shorter than V: **X** and Y

Thus, **'X'** is the only person senior but shorter than V.

Hence, **'option 1' **is the correct answer.
